text: The changed all-folder appearance test checks database flags and the visible tree body role, so persisted settings cannot alone satisfy the intended UI result. Review rejected a negated bitwise check against kNone; fixed IDL defines kNone as0, and fixed test uses Assert.equal against that value. The landing applied equality but retained a wrong grouped-by-sort diagnostic; fixed source now says unthreaded. Check actual assertion operands and messages instead of assuming every accepted suggestion landed. Existing selected-folder reload/default propagation findings are reused. Grouped-by-Sort propagation was later clarified as a separate issue. No test or UI execution ran.
